verses.text: Haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel tik: Winhaj Rubén, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón,
winhaj Dan, winhaj José, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Neftalí, winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Haton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán yet' winhaj Sela. Ha snun heb' winh oxwanh tik, haton ix yisil winhaj Súa aj Canaán. Ha winhaj Er chi' b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Judá, te chuk sb'eyb'al winh, yuj chi' ix satjiel winh yuj Jehová.
Haxo ix Tamar, ix yalib' winhaj Judá chi', ay chawanh yune' ix yet' winh: Haton winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zera. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá chi' owanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Fares chi': Haton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zera chi': Haton winhaj Zimri, winhaj Etán, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Calcol yet' winhaj Dara. Owanh heb' t'a smasanil.
Haxo winhaj Carmi smam winhaj Acán. Ha winhaj Acán chi' ix ik'ankot ya'elal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel, yujto ix yik'kot juntzanh tas winh t'a skal tas ix yal Dios to satjiel t'a junelnhej.
Haxo yuninal winhaj Etán, haton winhaj Azarías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hezrón: Haton winhaj Jerameel, winhaj Ram yet' winhaj Quelubai.
Ha winhaj Ram chi' smam winhaj Aminadab. Haxo winhaj Aminadab chi' smam winhaj Naasón. Ha winhaj Naasón yajal ix aj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.
Ha winhaj Naasón chi' smam winhaj Salmón. Ha winhaj Salmón chi' smam winhaj Booz.
Ha winhaj Booz chi' smam winhaj Obed, haton winh smam winhaj Isaí.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', haton heb' winh tik: B'ab'el winhaj Eliab, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Simea,
schanhil winhaj Natanael, yo'il winhaj Radai,
swakil winhaj Ozem, yukil winhaj David.
Eb' ix yanab' heb' winh tik: Haton ix Sarvia yet' ix Abigail. Haxo heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Abisai, winhaj Joab, winhaj Asael.
Haxo winh yune' ix Abigail chi', haton winhaj Amasa. Ha winh smam winhaj Amasa chi', haton winhaj Jeter ismaelita.
Haxo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Hezrón, ay jun yuninal winh skuch Jeriot, yune' ix Azuba. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yune' ix: Haton winhaj Jeser, winhaj Sobab yet' winhaj Ardón.
Haxo ix cham ix Azuba chi', haxo ix Efrata ix yik' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ay jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Hur.
Ha winhaj Hur chi' smam winhaj Uri. Haxo winhaj Uri chi' smam winhaj Bezaleel.
Ayik 60 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Hezrón, ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Maquir winh, haton winh smam winhaj Galaad. Ix alji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hezrón chi', haton winhaj Segub.
Ha winhaj Segub chi' smam winhaj Jair. Ha winhaj Jair chi' ayoch yajalil t'a 23 chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Galaad.

Haxo pax heb' aj Gesur yet' heb' aj Aram ix ik'ankan juntzanh schonhab' winhaj Jair chi' yet' chonhab' Kenat yet' yaldeail, 60 chonhab'il t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Maquir.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Hezrón chi', haxo winhaj Caleb ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Efrata. Ix alji jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Asur smam yicham heb' aj Tecoa.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jerameel tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Hezrón: Winhaj Ram winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Buna, winhaj Orén, winhaj Ozem yet' winhaj Ahías.
Ha winhaj Jerameel chi', ay junxo ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Atara snun winhaj Onam.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ram tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jerameel: Winhaj Maaz, winhaj Jamín yet' winhaj Equer.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Onam chi': Haton winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Jada. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Samai chi': Haton winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abisur.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abisur chi', haton ix Abihail. Ha ix chi' snun winhaj Ahbán yet' winhaj Molid.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nadab chi': Haton winhaj Seled yet' winhaj Apaim. Ha winhaj Seled chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Haxo winhaj Apaim chi' smam winhaj Isi. Haxo winhaj Isi chi' smam winhaj Sesán. Haxo winhaj Sesán chi' smam winhaj Ahlai.
Haxo winhaj Jada yuk'tak winhaj Samai, a winh smam winhaj Jeter yet' winhaj Jonatán. Ha winhaj Jeter chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi': Haton winhaj Pelet yet' winhaj Zaza. Ha heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Jerameel.
Ha winhaj Sesán, malaj yuninal winh, yuj chi' a junok heb' ix yisil winh ix yik'laj sb'a yet' jun winh schekab' winh skuch Jarha aj Egipto. Ix alji jun yune' ix skuch Atai.

Haton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Atai t'a stzolal: Winhaj Natán, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Eflal, winhaj Obed, winhaj Jehú, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Heles, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Sismai, winhaj Salum, winhaj Jecamías yet' winhaj Elisama.
Ha winhaj Caleb yuk'tak winhaj Jerameel chi', a winh smam winhaj Mesa b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Zif yet' winhaj Maresa smam winhaj Hebrón.
Haxo winhaj Hebrón chi' smam winhaj Coré, winhaj Tapúa, winhaj Requem yet' winhaj Sema.
Haton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Sema t'a stzolal: Winhaj Raham, winhaj Jorcoam, winhaj Requem, winhaj Samai, winhaj Maón yet' winhaj Bet-sur.
Ha ix Efa schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb, haton ix ay yune' winhaj Harán, winhaj Mosa yet' winhaj Gazez. Haxo winhaj Harán chi' smam junxo winhaj Gazez.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jahdai: Haton winhaj Regem, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Gesam, winhaj Pelet, winhaj Efa yet' winhaj Saaf.

Haxo ix Maaca schab'il pax yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb chi', a ix ay yune' winhaj Seber yet' winhaj Tirhana. Hanheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Saaf smam winhaj Madmana. Hanheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Seva smam winhaj Macbena yet' winhaj Gibea. Haxo ix yisil winhaj Caleb chi', haton ix Acsa.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hur, winh sb'ab'el une' ix Efrata, haton winhaj Sobal, winh smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim,
winhaj Salma, smam yicham heb' aj Belén yet' winhaj Haref smam yicham heb' aj Bet-gader.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sobal smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Haton winhaj Haroe, nanhal heb' manahetita,
yet' junjun makan heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Haton heb' itrita, heb' futita, heb' sumatita yet' heb' misraita. Haton t'a heb' chi' ix kot heb' zoratita yet' heb' estaolita.
Haxo winhaj Salma ix kajnajkan t'a chonhab' Belén. Ha winh smam yicham heb' netofatita, heb' aj Atrot-bet-joab yet' nanhalxo heb' manahetita, heb' zoraíta,
yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' soferita ix ek' kajan t'a Jabes, haton heb' tirateo, heb' simateo yet' heb' sucateo. Yet' heb' ceneo kotnak t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hamat smam yicham heb' yinhtilal Recab.
